    Chains and tackles of a ray category (BGRS 1.9, 8.4) #

    A chain is a zigzag x₀ -ρ₀→ z₀ ←σ₀- x₁ -ρ₁→ z₁ ← … of nonzero morphisms in which no peak (ρᵢ, σᵢ) and no valley (σᵢ, ρᵢ₊₁) closes to a commutative triangle. We store it as the list of its morphisms (as ray morphisms), with alternating peak and valley conditions between consecutive entries (RayCat.IsChainFrom). A tackle is a chain whose last morphism is irreducible; its efficiency is the word of depths of its morphisms.
